name: HauntedStands
description: At night, armor stands slowly creep toward the nearest player whenever nobody is looking directly at them.
usage: Place an armor stand nearby, wait for night, then look away and see it creep closer
manual: Once night falls, every armor stand on the server quietly checks whether any nearby player is watching it. If nobody is looking directly at it (and there's a clear line of sight), it inches toward the closest player and turns to face them, sometimes with a soul particle puff and a low creaking sound. The night-only knob (default true) controls whether this only happens at night or all the time. move-distance (default 0.15 blocks) sets how far it creeps per pulse, and move-period-ticks (default 20, i.e. once a second) sets how often pulses happen. detection-range (default 16 blocks) is how far away a stand can sense a player, watch-angle (default 15 degrees) is how precisely a player must be looking at it to freeze it, and stop-distance (default 2.0 blocks) is how close it will get before stopping. sound-chance (default 0.15) is the odds of a creepy sound and particle playing on any given move. Turn around and watch closely - it stops dead the instant you look at it.
creator: Rcon

versions.prompt: haunted armor stands: at night armor stands slowly creep toward the nearest player when nobody is looking directly at them

config.description: Whether stands only creep at night (turn off for constant haunting).
How far a stand creeps per movement pulse, in blocks.
Ticks between movement pulses (20 ticks = 1 second).
Max distance at which a stand will detect and creep toward a player.
Angle in degrees within which a player counts as looking directly at a stand, freezing it.
Distance from the target player at which a stand stops creeping closer.
Chance each pulse that a moving stand plays a creepy sound and particle burst.
